issues.detail: The Hebrew 'כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי' means 'for You are with me' (second person, addressing God). The Vietnamese renders it as 'vì Đức Giê-hô-va ở cùng tôi' ('for Jehovah is with me'), changing the second-person address to a third-person reference to God. This alters the person and the direct address of the verse.
